consumerAdmission.scope: Reviewed static alive-prone pose only, selected by confirmed status. Shared generic admission remains separate.

calibration.method: Manual comparison of face/nose and large hands, not auto fit-to-width. Existing offline reviewer canvas used with same source pixels, no edits or resampling to saved art.
calibration.reason: 800 made face/hands look small beside standing pose.660 better matches broad head and massive hands while horizontal body is longer than standing projected height.
calibration.anchorMeaning: Manual belly/torso projected ground point, not feet or source image center.

constraints: Only confirmed prone posture may select this pose.
Eyes remain open; no wounds, death, sleep, hit or stun inference.
Same bark skin, mossy grey fur, ragged waistcloth, root nose and upper-left light.
Needs mounted client scale/overlap and confirmed-state/fallback QA before runtime admission.
